summary: Iteration 16: Validated TRC20-only enforcement and new /ledger background export button. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS (test_iteration16.py): channels/chain addresses are TRC20-only; POST /api/orders with network='ERC20' is correctly forced to TRC20 server-side (build_order line 641); POST /api/export/ledger returns job id, job completes with status='done', xlsx (PK) downloadable, missing account_id -> 400; /api/dashboard/stats OK. Frontend: /channels add dialog shows data-testid='channel-network-fixed' = 'USDT · TRC20' with no network select; /orders has NO filter-network and create dialog shows data-testid='order-network-fixed' = 'USDT · TRC20' and creation succeeds (toast + new SF order visible as TRC20); /addresses has no network filter and shows no ERC20/BEP20 text; /developer try-network-fixed = TRC20 and live POST /api/v1/orders returns {code:0, network:'TRC20'}; /ledger shows data-testid='ledger-bg-export-btn' which posts /api/export/ledger and displays '已加入后台导出' toast; /exports lists '资金流水' (ledger) jobs with status 已完成 and download icons.

issues: Code example at ApiDocsPage.jsx:151 still has inline comment '// TRC20 | ERC20 | BEP20' for the network field, even though only TRC20 is supported. Misleading for integrators — update comment to 'TRC20'.
React hydration warning persists: <span> rendered inside <option> for merchant-select. Noisy but harmless (also flagged in iteration 14).

action_items: (Minor) Update ApiDocsPage.jsx line 151 code example comment: '// TRC20 | ERC20 | BEP20' -> '// TRC20 (only supported)' to match the enforced UI/backend behavior.
(Optional, from iter14) Resolve <span> inside <option> hydration warning on /developer merchant-select.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_order() unconditionally sets network='TRC20' (line 641) — correctly ignores client-supplied value. The orders POST endpoint does NOT reject ERC20/BEP20 input but silently coerces; consider logging a WARN or returning 400 for explicit non-TRC20 input so integrators get fast feedback instead of a confusing silent conversion.
server.py export_jobs download endpoint returns 410 'file expired' on GridFS miss — good UX; ledger kind requires account_id (400 enforced).
/exports page shows the historical 分润快照 and 订单 jobs alongside 资金流水 (same table) which is correct and consistent.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST orders during test_create_order_forces_trc20_even_if_erc20_sent and 2 ledger export jobs (both completed and downloadable).
